page.layout: One page of text, single column, with the right edge cut off by the scan. Running head at top centre. No marginal notes. Page number at top left.

main_text.l: κυριακὴν refipiente, appelletur. Et hæc ra-
tio, quare Dominica dies appelletur, ma-
nifesta est, & ea satis est. Neque cogit hoc
minum de eo die Ecclesiæ præceptum de-
disse; etiámsi fortassé actio aliqua Dominica
vel præcepta sit. ---- Quùm igitur primâ
quàm alia omnia credimus) & ab aliis
rum aliquid apud se ponerent, unde para-
ta esset, quùm ad ipsos venisset, eleëmosyna
in sanctos; idque is testètur se etiàm

page.notes: The right edge of the page is cut off, so the line ends are incomplete (for example "Apostolo", "alio", "aliquando"). Greek words are transcribed approximately. Heading-like "quand" at the foot right is the cut-off word "quando". The word "kirche" is black letter and approximated. The line "ú" is a doubtful reading. Running head and page number are as printed; a digitiser watermark is omitted.
